entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, you can help me by taking back these garbage cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable!

I can certainly look into that for you, and I understand your frustration. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

They're junk! I've tried them on three rides and they've given me horrible blisters. And the placement for the cleats feels totally wrong, I can't get them adjusted properly. I don't want to 'fix' them, I want a refund. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters and discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Michael Sterling. I don't have the order number, just look me up! I've spent thousands with you people. If I don't get a refund for these, I'm blasting VeloFit all over my cycling club's forum. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, Mr. Sterling, and there's no need to speak with a manager, as I can absolutely resolve this for you. I'm pulling up your account now... yes, I see you're one of our VIP members, we appreciate your loyalty. I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, purchased 71 days ago.
Don't give me the runaround on the date! I expect better service than this.

Not at all, sir. I was just confirming the details. The good news is that our standard return policy for items like these cycling shoes is 90 days. You are well within the window, so I can process a full refund for you immediately.
Oh. So... you're just going to approve it? Just like that?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return process. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. And for the trouble you've had with the blisters and as a thank you for being a VIP customer, I've also added a $25 store credit to your account for your next purchase. You can expect your refund to be processed as soon as the return is received at our warehouse.
Wow. Okay. That's... actually great service. I appreciate that, David. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mr. Sterling. We want to make sure you're happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
